Title: IConnection & IConnectionProvider - LLM Connectors
Summary: Contracts for connecting to LLM backends. IConnection handles per-chat communication via ChatMessageContent, IConnectionProvider manages available connections and attaches them to kernels.
Content:
## IConnection & IConnectionProvider

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Contracts`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Core`

### IConnection
Handles communication with an LLM service provider. Kernel-locked (one per chat).

#### Methods

##### HandleAsync(ChatMessageContent content, CancellationToken ct = default)
Processes a chat message content. The connection sends the message to the LLM, handles streaming responses, and manages tool calls.

```csharp
Task HandleAsync(ChatMessageContent content, CancellationToken ct = default);
```

##### FunctionCallStart()
Called by a dedicated function invocation filter to signal when a function call starts. Helps suppress "thinking" messages and reduce context.

```csharp
void FunctionCallStart();
```

### IConnectionProvider
Provides connections to LLM backends.

#### Methods

##### ListConnectionsAsync()
Lists all available connections.

```csharp
Task<IEnumerable<ConnectionInfo>> ListConnectionsAsync();
```

##### HasConnectionAsync(string id)
Checks if a connection exists.

```csharp
Task<bool> HasConnectionAsync(string id);
```

##### AttachAsync(IKernelBuilder builder, string connectionId)
Attaches a connection to a kernel builder. Returns `ConnectionInfo`.

```csharp
Task<ConnectionInfo> AttachAsync(IKernelBuilder builder, string connectionId);
```

### ConnectionInfo Record
```csharp
public record ConnectionInfo(
    string Id, 
    string Name, 
    string Source, 
    string ModelId, 
    IConnectionProvider Provider, 
    bool SupportImages, 
    bool SupportFiles
);
```
